name: Shader / WebGL Website
philosophy: The surface of the site is alive. A custom GPU-drawn material is the brand's visual signature, and everything else is restrained so it can breathe.
principles: One authored shader idea that belongs to this brand
The effect expresses a concept: water for a port, heat for a foundry
Type stays in the DOM and always readable
The quality ladder is part of the design
visualIdentity: Experiential and atmospheric: a living field of colour or texture with sparse, precise type over it. Studio-portfolio energy.
artDirection: Derive the shader from the brand concept and palette. Decide its scale, speed and grain on purpose, and repeat it in small doses across pages.

layout.composition: Large immersive fields alternating with very quiet text sections. Sparse grids, big margins.

typography: Sharp display type with wide spacing or strong contrast over the field, plus a readability scrim where the field moves behind text.
colour: Palette comes alive inside the shader; the interface stays nearly monochrome.
contentPresentation: Short and confident. Few words, strong statements, portfolio-like lists.
assets: The shader is the main asset. Very few photos, treated to match the field.
animation: Continuous slow motion in the field, reacting to pointer and scroll. Interface motion stays minimal.
scrolling: Native scroll. Scroll may shift the shader's parameters. Only one canvas runs at a time.
responsive: Quality ladder: full, reduced, then a CSS gradient or still frame. Text contrast is checked over the fallback too.
useCases: Accent backgrounds for a brand with a strong concept

compatibleWith.when: The story has one shader scene as a chapter

fromTeam: Workbook: custom GLSL for globe, ocean, landscape; ocean static, morphing incomplete
Skill: ShaderBackground with a quality ladder
Taste docs: headline must not be painted by the shader; scrim over moving fields
